anomalies.description: GET /time-entries/invoiced does NOT return 405 — returns application-level 'invalid_request: time not found'. Same anomaly on GET /invoices/info. Clockify router appears to allow GET on some PATCH/POST-only endpoints and dispatches them to a handler that returns application errors rather than enforcing 405 at routing level.
TRUTH.yaml iter20 suspicion that /user/{userId}/time-entries/{id}/duplicate is absent (based on /stop sibling) was WRONG. 405 on GET proves /duplicate exists. Subpath absence is not transitive.
